name: baidu_search
description: Search Baidu through the APK-derived (baiduboxapp) anonymous search flow and return the aggregated multi-page result JSON (same shape as the Python baidu_search client, plus provider/ok). Per-page failures are recorded in diagnostics.errors and already-fetched pages are kept.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to fetch

name: baidu_search_page
description: Fetch and parse exactly one Baidu search-result page. With page_url omitted the first-page URL is built from query; otherwise page_url is fetched as-is (server-issued pagination URL). The optional page (1-based) builds the URL for that page instead (pn offset), taking precedence over page_url. Failures return {provider, ok:false, error:{kind,message,url,status_code}} with the Python client's error kind.

page_url.description: Optional server-issued page URL to fetch as-is

page.description: Optional 1-based page number; the page URL is built from the query (page 1 is the initial URL, later pages use the pn offset)

name: baidu_suggest
description: Fetch Baidu search suggestions from the app's suggestion systems: inputbox (the AI input box: chat suggestions and content groups), classic (the classic sug endpoint) and recommendations (SugRec related/guess words). With system omitted only inputbox is queried: on current server behaviour classic and recommendations both answer HTTP 404 (measured 2026-11-17); name one in system to query it anyway. Per-system failures are recorded in the systems field instead of failing the call.

system.description: Optional: query only this suggestion system (default: inputbox)

name: baidu_parse_search_results
description: Parse a saved Baidu (APK/wise) search-result HTML page into structured JSON, offline (no network). Returns the Python baidu_parser page dict plus provider/ok.

query.description: Search query the page belongs to

page_url.description: URL the HTML was fetched from (for relative-URL resolution and pn detection)

name: baidu_build_search_url
description: Build the first-page Baidu search URL for a query (APK bq0.m reproduction: pu merges, https upgrade, ant_ct, t_samp). now_ms pins the clock for reproducibility; omit for the current time.

now_ms.description: Optional epoch milliseconds to pin the generated URL

name: baidu_list_sources
description: List the search providers and tools supported by Baidu_MCP.
